userStories.title: Harness-drivable setup guidance (#282 spell half, PRD D-02)
userStories.description: spell-arcane-version and spell-open-session: where they direct the operator to `spell update`, add: when `spell update` reports skipped manifest questions (no interactive terminal), collect each answer through the harness's own question UI and re-run with the flags it printed (`--role`, `--tracking-mode`, `--external-provider`, `--content-sensitivity`, `--push-policy`, `--subject-root`); never pass a flag the operator did not answer; loosening push_policy is never done by flag (only `spell unblock-push`, interactive).
acceptanceCriteria: new test asserts the flag names match the CLI's (read src/index.ts)
userStories.testEvidence: test/up03-d-harness-setup-flags.test.ts: 11/11 pass (flag names parsed from src/index.ts; mutation --subject-root->--subject-dir caught); 12 related spell/prompt test files 281/281; self-host parity, citations, ADR refs pass
